            q.ρ ≤ 1 →
              ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal),
                Monotone τ →
                  ∀
                    (O :
                      OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                        (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n)),
                    outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                      ∀ (N : ℕ),
                        outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.eventLimit q ≤ N →
                          have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                          have elapsed := fun z =>
                            ↑(OracleTemplate.execute O (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.factory q) (fun x => N) z.1 z.2).2;
                          Measurable elapsed ∧
                            ∫⁻ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)),
                                  elapsed z ∂P ≤
                                outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.multisetTimeBound τ q.m +
                                  ↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.rounds q) *
                                    (ENNReal.ofReal q.ρ * outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.multisetTimeBound τ q.m +
                                      ENNReal.ofReal (1 - q.ρ) *
                                        (4 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑q.S)) ∧
                              (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.largeSample q.m q.n →
                                ∫⁻ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)),
                                    elapsed z ∂P ≤
                                  5 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑q.m +
                                    ↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.rounds q) *
                                      (ENNReal.ofReal q.ρ * (5 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑q.m) +
                                        ENNReal.ofReal (1 - q.ρ) *
                                          (4 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑q.S)))
